_doc: Rig config: bimanual I2RT YAM (6-DoF + parallel gripper). Paths are relative to this file. The arm calibration (right base pose, cameras) and the table plane are read per episode from calib.json unless overridden here.

robot._finger_doc: finger joint = closed + g * (open - closed), g = recorded normalised gripper (1 = open); matches the recorder's own FK to 0.001 mm

calibration._doc: null = take calib.json T_lb_rb / table_n, table_d from the episode
